stem: Internal router R5 in NSSA area 1 learns 0.0.0.0/0 in two ways: an O IA route from the ABR with a total cost of 20, and an O N2 route from an ASBR in the area with metric 1. Which route does R5 install?
options: The O N2 route, because its metric of 1 is lower than 20
The O IA route, because OSPF prefers inter-area routes over NSSA external routes regardless of metric

Metrics are compared only between routes of the same type, so the O IA default wins even though the N2 metric is lower.
